title: Tester agent output
description: Tester's structured Test plan + skill invocation + verdict.  v0.4 replaces the v0.3 markdown (## Test plan / ## Skill invocation / ## Verdict).  ACCEPT terminates the loop; FAIL feeds back to the Coder via the reflector pattern; the `## ERROR:` exit migrates to the shared error_envelope.schema.json.

test_name.description: <verb>_<subject>_<condition>; must match one of the names in the Coder's `test_coverage[].test_name` array.

covers_field.description: Architect-declared field this test exercises; or `(all)` for whole-block tests.

skill_invocation.description: Canonical `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` with an optional `-- <name>` filter when ≤4 specific test names need running.  Pattern enforces the W19 Fri Tester corpus convention.

verdict.description: ACCEPT → coverage exercises every Architect-declared range/enum check.  FAIL → at least one coverage gap (populated in `gaps[]`).

should_assert.description: What the missing test should assert (declarative, parseable by the Coder's revision turn).

gaps.description: Required non-empty when verdict == FAIL; absent or empty when verdict == ACCEPT.
